# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps within the same track never overlap and must chain one to the next, so anything happening in parallel belongs in a separate track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a single `seconds` value), `variable` (with `minSeconds`, `maxSeconds`, and optionally `defaultSeconds`), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped, with `defaultSeconds` for planning). A **startTrigger** anchors each step to time or causality—`programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (at an offset), `afterStep` (when another step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when another step ends plus a delay), `manual` (user taps), `onAbort` (conditional), or `compound` (multiple conditions). **stepIds must be unique across the entire program**, not just within a track. Every `task` that a step claims needs a matching `resourceConstraints` entry, and that entry's `maxConcurrent` value enforces the hard limit—one oven, one grill, two burners, etc. Repeated work (three trays, six samples, two aircraft landings) goes into one step with `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial"|"parallel"|"stagger"}`, never as n copied steps; chain what follows each instance with `instances: "each"`, give the barrier (the step that waits for all instances) `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area between them only fits k at a time (a cooling rack for two trays, a rotor for six tubes), set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` to stall the upstream work instead of leaving the downstream items stranded.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global; repeated work uses replicates on one step, chained with instances",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "smoker", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "grill", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "burner", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "cooler", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "prep", "maxConcurrent": 2 }
  ],
  "actors": 2
}
```
